compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: Stephen recounts Egypt, the Red Sea, wilderness wonders, and resistance to Moses.
observations.label: A history used as accusation

observations.body: Stephen selects Moses, signs, the assembly, living words, idols, and the witness tent from the wilderness story.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Acts 7:28–46 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: The retelling honors Moses while accusing the ancestors of refusing him.
payload.title: Stephen retells signs and refusal
